notes: Flagship Opus tier.

notes: Current Anthropic default cell (CUP) in the app catalogue.

name: Haiku 4.5
notes: Fastest and cheapest Anthropic model.

name: Gemini 3.5 Flash
notes: Current Gemini default (both roles) in the app catalogue. Gemini caching is implicit — no separate write charge in usageMetadata.

name: Gemini 3.1 Pro
notes: Most capable Gemini (preview). Prices are the <=200k-prompt tier; >200k is 4/18.

name: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite
notes: Cheapest, fastest Gemini. Text/image/video input rate; audio input is 0.50.

name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
notes: Previous-gen Flash. Text/image/video input rate; audio input is 1.00.

name: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite
notes: Cheapest Gemini overall. Text/image/video input rate; audio input is 0.30.

name: GPT-5.5
notes: Current OpenAI default primary (QM) in the app catalogue. Text+image input only; audio needs the gpt-realtime family.

name: GPT-5.4 Mini
notes: Current OpenAI default cell (CUP) in the app catalogue.

name: GPT-5.4
notes: Mid flagship — cheaper than 5.5, stronger than mini.

name: GPT-5.4 Nano
notes: Cheapest OpenAI cell candidate.

name: GPT-5.5 Pro
notes: Top reasoning tier. Reference only — served via the Responses API, not chat completions, so the app engine can't call it and it isn't swept.

name: GLM-4.7 (Cerebras)
notes: Z.ai's open-weight flagship served on Cerebras's free developer tier (prices are the free tier — $0). Bench-only provider; free-tier caps: 30 RPM, 14,400 RPD, ~1M tokens/day as of 2026-07. Lineup and limits change without notice — verify at inference-docs.cerebras.ai before relying on this row.

name: GPT-OSS 120B (Cerebras)
notes: OpenAI's open-weight 120B MoE served on Cerebras's free developer tier (prices are the free tier — $0); ~1,800-3,000 tok/s, the fastest host for this model. Same free-tier caps and verify-before-trusting caveat as zai-glm-4.7.

name: Qwen3 Coder (OpenRouter free)
notes: Strongest :free tool-calling/coding model as of 2026-07 — the free primary (patch) pick. Free-plan caps: 20 req/min; ~50 req/day on a $0 account, 1,000/day after a one-time $10 credit purchase. :free endpoints 404 unless the account's privacy settings allow free model publication; the lineup rotates without notice — verify at openrouter.ai/models before relying on this row.

name: Llama 3.3 70B (OpenRouter free)
notes: Long-lived :free workhorse — the free cell pick (fast, non-reasoning, fine for bulk classification). Same free-plan caps, privacy-settings requirement, and rotation caveat as qwen/qwen3-coder:free.

name: Hy3 (OpenRouter free)
notes: Tencent's 295B MoE (21B active) — reasoning modes, stable tool calling. FREE ROUTE ENDS 2026-07-21; paid hy3 is 0.14/0.58 per Mtok. Same free-plan caps and privacy-settings requirement as the other :free rows.

name: Nemotron 3 Ultra (OpenRouter free)
notes: NVIDIA's 550B MoE (55B active) frontier agent model, 1M context, ~300 tok/s. No announced end date for the free route. Same free-plan caps and privacy-settings requirement as the other :free rows.

name: Laguna M.1 (OpenRouter free)
notes: Poolside's coding model, hosted by Poolside itself. Same free-plan caps, privacy-settings requirement, and rotation caveat as the other :free rows.

name: Gemma 4 31B (OpenRouter free)
notes: Google's open-weights mid-size instruct model; many host providers, so the free route is less saturation-prone than single-host models. Same free-plan caps, privacy-settings requirement, and rotation caveat as the other :free rows.

name: Nemotron 3 Super (OpenRouter free)
notes: NVIDIA's 120B MoE (12B active), 1M context, hosted by Nvidia. Same free-plan caps, privacy-settings requirement, and rotation caveat as the other :free rows.

name: North Mini Code (OpenRouter free)
notes: Cohere's compact coding model, hosted by Cohere. Same free-plan caps, privacy-settings requirement, and rotation caveat as the other :free rows.
